metadata.note: 1988 70-degree V4 crank phasing is unverified; evenly spaced phases are an acoustic estimate, not a claimed ignition order. Lower front-pair pipes are longer and cross underneath to the right. One cycle per revolution. Four independent pipes; straight chamber and stinger surrogates. Port area approximated by a 28 mm equivalent circle, 200 degrees open. All pipe dimensions and port timing are engineering estimates; see docs/racing-vehicles.md.
